answer.explanation: From 22:27:17 onward, ThumbnailerFunction logged repeated AccessDenied errors on s3:PutObject to lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi/thumbnailer/*. The error states that no identity-based policy allows the action. The role's only inline policy, app-policy, grants s3:GetObject on the input bucket only (ReadInput). It grants no PutObject on the output bucket. The failures run through the whole window, roughly 30-40 per minute. The CrudApi, Uploader and Compression logs show no AccessDenied or timeout errors in the window.
